prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1444; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good afternoon. This is the adjuster following up on the claim for the sideswipe collision. Is it all right if I record this statement?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please state where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving on the frontage road in Baytown, Texas, and I was trying to move over into the right lane to make my exit.

Q: Can you describe what you saw before you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and it looked clear. I put on my signal and started to move over slowly. I didn't see the other car until it was already next to me.

Q: Where did the vehicles make contact?

A: Their passenger side scraped along my driver side, near the rear door. It was a long scrape, not a hard impact.

Q: Did you stop at the scene?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder right away and waited for the other driver to stop too. We exchanged information and a police officer came out.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, and the pain goes up into my head sometimes. I felt it the next morning, and it has been getting a little worse with the turning of my head.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other provider for this?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care and I'm now seeing a physical therapist twice a week.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get back to normal.

Q: Thank you for your time. We will follow up in writing.
